history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person stands in front of a vibrant display of pink bougainvillea flowers, posing with a hand gesture near their red cap. They are wearing a black hooded jacket, loose-fitting light-wash denim jeans, and stylish black and white sneakers. The background features buildings, utility poles with electrical wires, and a street with a parked car partially visible behind a metal fence intertwined with more flowering vines. The lighting suggests it's late afternoon, with a soft, warm glow illuminating the scene. The overall mood is casual and relaxed, with a touch of urban vibrancy from the flowers and architecture. The color palette is a mix of soft blues from the sky, bright pinks from the flowers, and earthy tones from the ground and buildings. The image has a slightly desaturated, naturalistic feel. The red cap has white text, which appears to be "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN".
